children: Sweden furniture group's Q3 net sales rose 1.7% yr/yr, driven by currency effects
Adjusted operating profit for Q3 increased to 11.5 mln SEK from 6.9 mln SEK
Order intake jumped 20.8% and order backlog rose 15.2% yr/yr
Company maintains target of 8–10% EBIT margin in a normalised market
Company sees opportunities in geographical expansion and digital sales development
Lammhults plans continued investments in market presence, digitalisation, and product development
OFFICE INTERIORS - Co said sales growth and improved profitability in Office Interiors helped drive results
LIBRARY WEAKNESS - Co said Library Interiors sales declined 4.6% yr/yr
COST CONTROL - Co attributed stable performance to continued cost control and positive mix effects
